content.content: A verb that needs a resolved workspace refuses when the context is root-less, naming the absence; init is the one verb that does not.
content.rationale: Root-optional makes a root-less context a state (S3-root-optional), so a verb that reaches for the store needs an answer for its absence. Refusing — the same value the envelope renders (S4) — keeps a missing workspace one failure with one shape, and leaves init's exemption (IN-entry) the only special case.
